The '''"yoghurt plant,"'''<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> also spelt as '''"yogurt" plant''',<ref name="TAoSW">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> and as '''yogurt plant''',<ref name="RF">{{InsiderCite|144|Red Five|Red Five: Paul Bateman}}</ref> was a type of [[Swamp/Legends|paludial]] [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I like how alien his version of Dagobah is, too: full of little spotted yogurt plants and creepy roots. To me, Ralph was an artistic Yoda of sorts&mdash;full of a magical wit and wisdom&mdash;so I have an especially soft spot for this piece.|[[Paul Bateman]], on [[Ralph McQuarrie]]'s production painting|<ref name="RF" />}}
The "yoghurt plant" was introduced in the [[1980]] reference book ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' on a production painting drawn by [[Ralph McQuarrie]].<ref name="TAoSW" />
